hazardous_situation: A write is linked to the wrong patient or encounter
potential_patient_harm: A record shows the wrong patient's location or status
initiating_conditions: Reused or non-unique visit number; a schema moving standard fields; merged or linked records
affected_routes: Recovery to a receiver with an API
existing_controls: Gate blocks PATIENT_MISMATCH and UNKNOWN_ENCOUNTER, and treats unreadable as unknown
proposed_controls: Confirm PV1-19 is unique at the receiver; approval on every write; a person checks the receiver after each write
verification_evidence: Demo receiver or stub only; repeat on yours
remaining_uncertainty: Shutter compares one visit at a time and doesn't see other visits, merges or linked numbers. An admission passes this check if the receiver has no record of that encounter
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: A plan rests on stale or incomplete receiver evidence
potential_patient_harm: A correct newer entry is overwritten, or a needed update is missed
initiating_conditions: A receiver that returns part of its history; a change that doesn't move its version; a lag in its reads
existing_controls: Conditional write on the receiver's version; a fresh read and second gate before the write; approval void if the version moves
verification_evidence: Demo receiver or stub only; repeat on yours
remaining_uncertainty: A partial history or an ignored condition isn't detected. Two systems moving a patient a second apart are ordered by their stated times
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: The same message is delivered through two routes
potential_patient_harm: A movement applied twice, or an old one reapplied after a newer one
initiating_conditions: An engine operation with FailureTimeout -1 retrying while Shutter also resends
affected_routes: Receiver with an API and an engine feed
existing_controls: The onboarding plan warns of FailureTimeout -1. A receipt for the operation key blocks a second write by Shutter
proposed_controls: FailureTimeout 0 on the operation; check the message trace before anyone re-enters anything
verification_evidence: Measured once on build 109 by the approved route. No automated test
remaining_uncertainty: Nothing stops it if the setting is left. How the receiver treats duplicates is for it to show
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: An acknowledgement is taken to mean more than it does
potential_patient_harm: A lost message is assumed filed, and care relies on a stale record
initiating_conditions: A transport or commit ACK; GetReply off; an application ACK that never comes
existing_controls: Onboarding plan states per operation what a completed message proves. Verified is never read from an ACK
proposed_controls: Ask the supplier what its ACK means; keep ordinary reconciliation running
verification_evidence: Measured on stock operations and a listener, not your receiver
remaining_uncertainty: Such a message opens no case: Shutter is silent about it
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: The result of a write is uncertain
potential_patient_harm: A person assumes it failed and re-enters it, or assumes it worked when it didn't
initiating_conditions: Lost answer; a receiver slower than the settling time; a gateway's 503 after the write
existing_controls: No answer or most 5xx is uncertain and goes to reading receipts. Never resent automatically
proposed_controls: Set UncertainSettleSeconds above the receiver's worst case; a named person reads the receiver for each uncertain attempt
verification_evidence: Demo receiver or stub only; repeat on yours
remaining_uncertainty: A slower receiver can commit after the case says not committed. A 503 from a gateway isn't read as uncertain
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: A manual exception has no owner
potential_patient_harm: A record stays wrong and nobody knows
initiating_conditions: No receiving-team owner; nobody watching the case list; out-of-hours failures
existing_controls: None that tells anyone: a case escalates after 24 hours undecided with no mail or alert. A person sends any draft
proposed_controls: A named owner and deputy before stage 3; daily review; stop when nobody can own a case
verification_evidence: Read in the code; the timeout itself has no test
remaining_uncertainty: A movement may stay unapplied for the wait plus however long a person takes. How long is acceptable is your judgement
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: A policy change allows writes it shouldn't
potential_patient_harm: A write with no person, or a merge or unconditional resend
initiating_conditions: An approver saves the profile; a tier left as shipped; an entry with no tier reads as tier 2
existing_controls: Each saved version is kept with who saved it; a save voids approvals. Merges and unconditional resends are forbidden as shipped
proposed_controls: Approval on every tier; a separate approver role without Shutter_Configure; read the history at each review
verification_evidence: Approval on every tier was tried in one run on the demo receiver. Separate roles not tested
remaining_uncertainty: One shipped role holds both rights by design, and an install restores it
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: Patient data reaches somewhere it shouldn't
initiating_conditions: Model use; email with NHS number and birth date; an error text echoing a name; no TLS by default
existing_controls: Tokens to a model and notes as flags; mail limited to allowed domains; a person sends each email
proposed_controls: Model off for the pilot; TLS on every route; decide retention (05)
verification_evidence: Checked on synthetic data only, by a privacy check over recordings. Not a run-time control
remaining_uncertainty: Tokens are pseudonyms. Identifiers can stay in other text; evidence is kept indefinitely unless purged
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: A stop doesn't stop, or is undone by accident
potential_patient_harm: Writes continue during a known problem
initiating_conditions: No single switch at 1.0.0; re-enabling a connector sends what it held; a case already past its final gate; a person without the right on call
existing_controls: Disabling the connector holds writes. Saving the profile voids held approvals. No switch exists at 1.0.0
proposed_controls: The stop drill in 07, by each person on the list, before stage 3; recovery on only when one is on call
verification_evidence: One run on 2026.2 with the demo receiver. A write already past the final gate wasn't tested
remaining_uncertainty: A stop doesn't touch the engine's own retries, and can't recall what's sent
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: A restore or failover invalidates the assumptions
potential_patient_harm: Old approvals or queues act on a changed record; a production fails to start
initiating_conditions: Restoring Shutter or the receiver; moving or dismounting Shutter's database
existing_controls: An approval is void if the receiver's version or epoch moves. At start, open cases are noted and none closed
proposed_controls: No failover or restore during the pilot; stop first; take namespaces off before moving the database
verification_evidence: Not tested: failover, mirrors and restore are untested
remaining_uncertainty: The dependency on Shutter's database was measured; recovery from it on your setup wasn't
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: A failure never becomes a case
potential_patient_harm: A wrong record with nobody aware, and false comfort from a quiet list
initiating_conditions: AlertOnError off; a forward refused while Shutter is down; over 2 MB; a new operation added after onboarding
existing_controls: Doctor lists refused forwards and unwatched operations. Alerts still reach your own consumer
proposed_controls: Keep ordinary alerting; coverage count in the daily review
remaining_uncertainty: A forward is never retried. The count of cases isn't the count of failures
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: A person trusts a plan or a verified result too far
potential_patient_harm: A wrong plan is approved, or a wrong record assumed right
initiating_conditions: Automation bias; a persuasive plan; reading verified as correct
existing_controls: The gate decides whether a write may go, whatever a plan says. Verified means the receipt and history held the key
proposed_controls: Train approvers to read the evidence; a person checks the receiver in stage 3
verification_evidence: Demo receiver or stub only; repeat on yours
remaining_uncertainty: A person may still approve a wrong plan. Verified compares no ward or bed, and a closed case isn't read again
review_trigger: Any change of scope, receiver or release; any stop; any incident

hazardous_situation: A forwarder sign-in opens an invented case

initiating_conditions: A leaked or misused forwarder password
existing_controls: Nothing checks that the message existed. Approval on every write means a person sees it
proposed_controls: Treat it as an integration credential; TLS; approval on every write
remaining_uncertainty: A person may still approve it
